integrity: The proof is analytic; verify.py supplies independently enumerable finite exact-rational checks, not an infinite-size certificate.
scientific_limitations: Exact calibration assumes independence and label-exchangeability; arbitrary same-label temporal dependence is excluded.
Circle-specific mean, covariance and joint limit assume independent uniform positions and fixed number of samples.
Earlier general matching work anticipates marginal Poisson limits; complete historical novelty is not certified.
No growing-sample-number theorem or uniform quantitative joint convergence rate is claimed.
title: Distribution-free overlap calibration and multiscale limits for reciprocal nearest neighbors
